Question: What is the minimum CGPA and standing arrear criteria for Tier-1 placement drives?
Common Student Phrasings: "cgpa needed for placements", "can i sit for placements with arrears", "tier 1 company criteria sathyabama", "cdc placement rules"
Answer: For core and Dream/Super-Dream Tier-1 recruitment (CTC > 8 LPA), students must maintain a minimum of 7.5 CGPA with zero standing (active) arrears. Tier-2 and mass drives generally allow students with up to 1 history arrear provided all subjects are cleared before the 7th semester.
